shadowCrowdRadius.description: The boot soft-shadow crowd radius (world units).

upscaleSharpness.description: The boot reduced-resolution reconstruction blend (0 bilinear .. 1 Catmull-Rom).

lighting.description: The scene's directional sun and ambient term. Optional, and every field within it is optional individually — an absent section, or an absent field within it, resolves to SdfFrame's pinned default for that field, so a world renders unchanged until it authors one.

sky.description: The procedural sky — a gradient, sun disc, star field, and distance fog. Optional; an absent section renders the pinned two-stop gradient and 0.015 fog density bit-exactly, as before this section existed.

cycle.description: Lighting and sky keyed over a state row's value (a day/night cycle when that row advances). Optional; absent leaves Lighting/Sky static.

state.description: The state row read (its slot cell; Fixed or Int).

keys.description: At least two keys, strictly ascending At in [0, 1).

at.description: The row-value fraction this key sits at, in [0, 1).

lighting.description: The lighting fields this key moves, or null.

sky.description: The sky fields this key moves, or null.

cycle.title: WorldRenderCycle

environment.description: The analytic studio-reflection softboxes and horizon gradient a GGX specular lobe reflects. Optional; absent (no softboxes, a black horizon) contributes nothing to the shaded color.

softboxes.description: The reflection softboxes, at most SdfEnvironment.MaxSoftboxes. Absent or empty contributes nothing.

items.description: One analytic studio-reflection softbox: a soft, angularly-extended highlight a GGX lobe catches in its mirror direction, widened by the surface's own roughness.

direction.description: From a reflecting surface toward the softbox, any nonzero length (normalized before upload).

size.description: The angular half-extent (width, height) the falloff widens by, both strictly positive.

color.description: BindableColor's grammar: the softbox's linear colour. Absent is white.
color.title: BindableColor

blur.description: Additional falloff softening, in the same units as Size. Absent is 0.

items.title: WorldRenderSoftbox

horizon.description: The reflection horizon gradient. Absent is black — contributes nothing.

low.description: The ground-ward (direction.y = −1) colour. Absent is black.
low.title: BindableColor

high.description: The sky-ward (direction.y = 1) colour. Absent is black.
high.title: BindableColor

horizon.title: WorldRenderHorizon

environment.title: WorldRenderEnvironment

tonemap.description: The tonemap applied to the frame's final color. Optional; absent is None — the stylized shaded color, unchanged.
tonemap.title: WorldTonemap

farDistance.description: The far distance in world units: the depth at which every camera march ends — the far plane the renderer's fine march exits at, the reach of the beam's cone proofs, and the depth the fog and depth ramps are measured against. Geometry beyond it is never marched, so an infinite plane ends on a visible horizon curve at this depth unless the sky fog has absorbed it (render.sky.fogDensity). Optional; absent resolves to the engine's pinned 40 — exactly the value every world marched to before this field existed. Must lie within [MinFarDistance, MaxFarDistance]. Re-read on every definition revision (a world.row.set render lands on the next frame); world.budget echoes it with its derived costs.
